bangkok.overview: Bangkok is a dense metropolis where walking means flat, paved paths rather than mountain trails. The best options are the shaded walkways of Lumphini Park in the city center and the elevated paths winding through the lush orchards of Bang Krachao across the river.

months.1: January offers the most comfortable walking weather of the year, with lower humidity and highs around 90 degrees making the paved paths of Lumphini Park pleasant.
months.7: Heavy rain is a regular occurrence, leaving the walkways of Bang Krachao slick and limiting walks to brief dry windows.
